title: C26 LISA PENDULUM PATHFINDER engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

geometry.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

drive_force.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

displacement.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.
displacement.x-quality-rule: Sensor floor, calibration and gaps retained.

ground_tilt.x-quality-rule: Common time base and cross-axis sign.

temperature.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

items.x-encoding: real and imag share the declared physical unit; covariance ordering and any complex pseudo-covariance are recorded in the sidecar.

identified_model.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.
identified_model.x-unit: kg, N s m^-1, N m^-1

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
